adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`, the `delete()` action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(...)` but does not attach a `.catch(...)` (unlike `save()`, which uses `.catch(popupAjaxError)`). If the DELETE request fails, the rejection is unhandled and the UI provides no error feedback; the row will also not be removed because `sendAction('deleteHost', ...)` only runs on success.
